attackers_goals: Gain persistence using the legitimate bitsadmin 'setnotifycmdline' mechanism, which triggers process executions once a Bits job is done or fails.
description: BITSAdmin.exe was used with a command-line that may indicate malware trying to gain persistence on the machine.
investigative_actions: Check if the command line contains any malicious indicators. Check if the parent process is suspicious. Check if the command-line used to persist is malicious or references a malicious binary.
name: Bitsadmin.exe persistence using command-line callback
